name: Sugarloaf Ridge SP
description: Sugarloaf Ridge State Park near Kenwood contains the headwaters of Sonoma Creek and trails to the summit of Bald Mountain. It is operated by the nonprofit Sonoma Ecology Center and is home to the Robert Ferguson Observatory.
fullDescription: Sugarloaf Ridge State Park near Kenwood contains the headwaters of Sonoma Creek and trails to the summit of Bald Mountain. It is operated by the nonprofit Sonoma Ecology Center and is home to the Robert Ferguson Observatory.
whatTheyOffer:
- Hiking, biking, and horseback riding trails
- Tent, RV, and group campsites (reserve at ReserveCalifornia.com)
- Robert Ferguson Observatory astronomy programs
- Day use hours 6am to 10pm
howToGetIt:
- Vehicle day use: $8
- Camping: reserve at ReserveCalifornia.com
- Park phone: (707) 833-6084

**Passes accepted at this park:**
- **California State Library Parks Pass**: Free vehicle day use; check one out from your public library
- **Golden Bear Pass**: Free vehicle day use for income-eligible Californians
- **Senior Golden Bear Pass**: $20/year for ages 62+ (not valid in peak season)
- **Disabled Discount Pass**: 50% off vehicle day use and camping
- **Distinguished Veteran Pass**: Free vehicle day use and camping for eligible veterans
keywords: Sugarloaf Ridge, state park, Sonoma County, Kenwood, hiking, camping, observatory, astronomy, waterfall
